sources.title: Qwen3 8B — AI Model Radar
sources.snippet: Qwen3 8B is an open-weights dense 8.2B parameter causal language model from Alibaba's Qwen series, designed for reasoning-heavy tasks and efficient dialogue. Released April 2025, it is available under the Apache 2.0 license with open access to weights. The model supports a 131,072 token context window and is suitable for both local deployment and API-based inference.
